description:
The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious undergraduate award, covering tuition, books, incidental fees and residence for four years. The process is nomination-based: schools must nominate by 9 October 2026, students apply for admission by 16 October 2026, and the scholarship application closes on 6 November 2026.

Programme Highlights

  • About 37 fully funded scholars selected each year across U of T's three campuses
  • Three-step timeline: school nomination (9 Oct), admission application (16 Oct), scholarship application (6 Nov 2026)
  • Only for first-entry undergraduate programmes, starting September 2027
  • Fraud notice: U of T works only through verified schools, never agents

Who Should Apply

International secondary-school students in their final year (or graduated no earlier than June 2026) requiring a Canadian study permit, nominated by their school as its top candidate.

Funding and Costs

Full tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years of undergraduate study (about 37 scholars per year).

Deadline and How to Apply

Secure your school's nomination first, submit the OUAC admission application by 16 October 2026, then complete the Pearson scholarship application by 6 November 2026.
